matrix.unknown: Module „{kind}" is not known to this version of the page.

app.baseFailed: The page „{path}” cannot be fetched ({why}) — public pages only, and only with live data.
app.baseLocked: The page „{path}” is encrypted — the preview will not open it.
app.noModule: No such module: {which} — give M1…M{count}, "modules[i]", an id or a kind.
app.pasteLede: Paste a page document (recreatio/page, a module or an old event document) — you will see the page as it will look after import. Nothing is saved.
app.gone: This preview no longer exists (the preview server was closed).
app.gonePaste: This preview no longer exists (the preview server was closed) — paste JSON.

doc.noTitle: The page has no title — the import will save neither the title nor the page text ("title" is needed to save "lead").
doc.images: Files from "images" ({count}): the preview shows files given by the assistant or placeholder images with a description — the person importing attaches the real ones.
doc.appointments: Appointments from "appointments" ({count}) are created only on import, in the calendar the importing person chooses — modules that point to them ("@key") show them only after import.
doc.form: {form}: the questions from the document ({count}) are created on import — the preview draws them from the document (layout and logic work; without the data controller clause, which comes from the area of the answers; sending disabled).
doc.menu: Menu as on the page „{page}” — the preview takes it from that page if it is public.

form.note: Preview: this form is created on import. Above the questions will stand the data controller clause of the area the answers go to; sending is disabled here.

knowledge.noView: There is no view „{view}” — views of this base: {list}.
knowledge.unknownAsked: This version of the app does not know the shape „{mode}” yet — the saved one is shown.
knowledge.noSavedView: The base has no saved view — all entries are shown.
knowledge.unknownSaved: The view has the shape „{mode}”, which this version of the app does not know yet — it is shown as a table.
knowledge.question: Question

lint.droppedKey: skipped on import (unknown, invalid or equal to the default): {value}
lint.listShort: of {count} entries the import takes {kept} — the others are invalid or unknown
lint.unknownPartKey: unknown key of the module „{label}” ({kind}) — nothing reads it
lint.unknownFrameKey: unknown key — a place is "position" { row, col } and "size" { colSpan, rowSpan }
lint.noSize: without the numbers "size.colSpan" and "size.rowSpan" — the import skips this place (the module goes to the first free one)

colMoved.one: {from} → {to} (the module does not fit in {count} column)
colMoved.other: {from} → {to} (the module does not fit in {count} columns)

lint.notColour: {value} is not a #rrggbb colour — the import takes the default colour
lint.notNightColour: {value} is not a #rrggbb colour — no night colours (all four are needed)
lint.unknownMenuKey: unknown key of a menu item — allowed: {list}
lint.menuNoLabel: item without "label" — the import skips it
lint.menuNoImage: not an image (page-image:<id>, https://… or /file.svg) — only the name stays
lint.menuDepth: the menu has at most 5 levels — deeper items are skipped
lint.configNotObject: "config" is not an object — the module stays empty
lint.owned: „{key}” is kept by the module itself — the import does not set it
lint.ownedNeeds: „{key}” is kept by the module itself — the import does not set it (form requirements: "needs" next to "questions")

probe.cutRight: „{text}” cut off on the right by {px} px
probe.cutBottom: „{text}” cut off at the bottom by {px} px
probe.cutBottomClamp: „{text}” cut off at the bottom by {px} px (line clamp)
probe.spills: content sticks out of the card: {list}
probe.sparse: the content fills {share}% of the card height ({px} px of empty space) — a smaller height (rowSpan) or more content
probe.stillLoading: was still loading when the picture was taken
probe.edgeCut: cut by the screen edge — {share}% visible
